title: The Fox and the Crow variant
summary: A crow perched high in an ancient oak holding a plump morsel of smoked bacon. A hungry fox sat beneath the tree and marveled aloud at her magnificent plumage and royal bearing....
keywords: the fox and the crow variant
full_text:
A crow perched high in an ancient oak holding a plump morsel of smoked bacon. A hungry fox sat beneath the tree and marveled aloud at her magnificent plumage and royal bearing.

"If only your melodious voice matched your queenly feathers," sighed the fox, "you would reign supreme over all birds!"

Puffed with conceit, the crow opened her beak wide to sing. The bacon plummeted into the open jaws of the fox, who laughed: "Your voice is harsh, mistress, but your bacon is delicious; next time, value your dinner above cheap compliments!"
moral: He who listens to the honeyed tongue of flattery surrenders his prize.
